Dispatch TOTALDEMAND at the 2026-07-29T07:55:00Z interval was 1964.83 MW (evidence_id: ev1152).
The half-hour operational demand for interval-ending 2026-07-29T08:00:00Z was 1872.0 MW (evidence_id: ev0535).

For the 24 half-hours around the event the forecast comparison reports mean_error_mw = 139.71 MW (POE50 − actual, evidence_id: ev0705) and MAE = 139.71 MW (evidence_id: ev0704), and for the 08:00 half-hour the paired POE50 was 2017.0 MW (evidence_id: ev0626) with error_mw = 145.0 MW (evidence_id: ev0628).

possible_explanations.statement: The spike might be related to tight dispatch offers or rebids coincident with the high demand at 2026-07-29T07:55:00Z (see ev1151 and ev1152).
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Inspect participant offer and rebid histories and the offer stack for 2026-07-29T07:55:00Z–2026-07-29T08:00:00Z.

possible_explanations.statement: The spike might be associated with interconnector flows or constraint changes; net interchange at the 2026-07-29T07:55:00Z peak was -162.76 MW (ev1153).
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Check interconnector availability and binding constraint records for 2026-07-29T07:55:00Z and surrounding dispatch intervals.

possible_explanations.statement: The spike might be attributable to a unit trip or other short-notice outage around 2026-07-29T07:55:00Z.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Examine unit trip reports, outage records and SCADA/dispatch event logs for 2026-07-29T07:55:00Z.

possible_explanations.statement: AEMO published Forecast LOR notices for SA for 29/07/2026 (see citations) which might have influenced market participant behaviour.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Compare participant rebids and offer stacks before and after the published LOR notices (see the cited market notices) to test whether bids changed following the notices.
